# What finitely many labels fix

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-finitely-many-labels-fix` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](what-finitely-many-labels-fix.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In a world a list of N holds, a feature is learnable through the map exactly where an extrapolation given at most N labelled names of N - 1 values learns it; its labels include every value the feature takes once it rests; where the map carries the feature, labels before a bound fix every later one.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A table of labelled names: a name is a finite future through the map, latest first, and a label a value of the feature; the extrapolation given a table unrolls the extrapolation by elimination over the lasso candidates and proposes the label of the first entry whose name the proposed future begins with. (`Becoming.Learning.prefix_map`, `Becoming.Identification.firstFit_mem`, `Becoming.Identification.firstFit_map`, `Becoming.Learnable.Begins`, `Becoming.Learnable.decBegins`, `Becoming.Learnable.byTable`, `Becoming.Learnable.entryOf`, `Becoming.Learnable.tableOf`, `Becoming.length_map`, `Becoming.Learnable.mem_map_of`, `Becoming.Learnable.tableOf_length`, `Becoming.Learnable.entryOf_name_length`, `Becoming.Learnable.tableOf_names`, `Becoming.Learnable.begins_entryOf`)
2. In a world a list of N holds, where configurations with the same future through the map have features agreeing from some step on, the extrapolation given the table of the N configurations as many steps on as the list is long, each named by its first N - 1 values through the map and labelled with its feature, rests in accord with the feature along every orbit and every run, from the bound of the extrapolation given nothing on; so a feature is learnable exactly where the extrapolation given some table of at most N labelled names of N - 1 values learns it. (`Becoming.Learnable.table_predicts`, `Becoming.Learnable.learnable_iff_table`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.table_predicts`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.learnable_iff_table`)
3. Every value the feature takes from the step an extrapolation given a table rests on is a label of an entry of the table; where the law leaves every configuration unchanged, every value the feature takes is. (`Becoming.Learnable.label_of_predicts`, `Becoming.Learnable.labels_of_still`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.labels_of_still`)
4. Where the map also carries the feature, every feature is learned by the extrapolation given nothing in a world a list holds, from the bound on, along every orbit and every run, and unrolled it proposes the feature at every step ahead: the labels before the bound fix every later one. (`Becoming.Learnable.predicts_with_labels`, `Becoming.Learnable.ahead_with_labels`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.predicts_with_labels`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.ahead_with_labels`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A determined law; a list holding the world (or the orbit, for the labels along the course); values through the map compared decidably, and the feature's values too where the map carries it.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- An extrapolation that finds the table: the table of the world is built from the world, the law and the feature, as fromWorld is.
- That names of fewer than N - 1 values, or fewer than N entries, fail in some world of N configurations (for telling configurations apart N - 1 is exact, Law.sameFuture_classes_exact; for the extrapolation given a table it is not stated); undetermined processes; probabilistic or approximate learning.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The chapter's open programme (section 8.2, Learning) named "learning a target from finitely many of its values, given part of a reading of the future rather than the whole". Ren, 18 October 2026: "alright, generally agree, please make your own pareto frontier decisions, and push the frontier - words are important, but i think you are capable" (provenance, not warrant); the AI chose the item. A table of labelled names is the finite part of the reading that suffices; the labels along the course are feedback the map carries.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- none
- related, not a proved adapter: [what-an-extrapolation-given-nothing-fixes](what-an-extrapolation-given-nothing-fixes.md). There a learnable feature is a reading of the future, a function on whole futures; here a finite part of it, at most N labelled names of N - 1 values, suffices.
- related, not a proved adapter: [learnable-through-a-map](learnable-through-a-map.md). There learnability is characterized with an extrapolation built from the law (fromLaw); here the extrapolation given a finite table learns every learnable feature, and where the map carries the feature along the course every feature is learned given nothing.
- related, not a proved adapter: [identification-where-bounded](identification-where-bounded.md). Moore's bound N - 1 (Law.sameFuture_iff_within) gives the length of the names.
